CustomField.description: Raw cosine value mapped to 0 when rescaling the semantic signal to [0,1]. ada-002 cosines compress into a high band (~0.70 for unrelated text), so a non-zero floor is required for the signal to discriminate. Default 0.70. Recalibrate from breakdown.semanticRaw against the eval set.
